reviews.text: Great caring and attentive staff. Highly recommend for your pets rehab needs
My dog hates water and they still got her to use the hydro tread.
I love this place!  The therapists are excellent.  They took my poor boy and gave him his life back through physical therapy.  He was never afraid to go here and always happy when he came out.

If I could give Jennie ten stars, I would. When we first arrived with Elle post her surgery for ivdd, we were all overwhelmed and unsure that she would ever walk again. But Jennie was constantly positive and encouraging, never doubting in our progress. Through everyone's hard work - and Jennie's incredible help - Elle is now running and playing almost like nothing happened! A big thank you to the team for all the help and encouragement.
They take only dogs.. rename it to dog only rehabilitation.

My dog recently had ACL surgery, and several weeks later, I took advantage of a free consult to meet with a PT and to check out the Dallas location.

After meeting Jenny and learning more about their rehab approach, I scheduled some sessions to see how we could kick-start my pup’s home rehab, which wasn’t going particularly well. Their willingness to do the hard work to push through her discomfort was, frankly, something I was neither good at nor comfortable doing.

While progress was slow initially, suffice it to say that the rehab delivered positive results… and I’m 100% positive that my dog’s successful recovery and return to “normal” activity (trust me, my pup is anything but normal) was due in large part to the rehab team’s expert assistance.

Besides being unfailingly kind and patient, both Jenny and Dana (the PTs on staff) were honest about progress, and helpful re things to try at home to accelerate my pup’s recovery.

I wouldn’t hesitate to use their services again if/when needed, and based on my experiences, I highly recommend them to anyone seeking vet rehab!
So happy with the progress our dog has made since her TPLO surgery.  If you're pet is in need of PT we highly recommend North Texas Animal Rehabilitation.

We started our rehab journey with North Texas Animal Rehab as soon as we could after our dog’s TPLO surgery.  We’ve have the greatest experience so far and can really tell the difference it’s making in her recovery. We love that our girl gets so excited as soon as we pull. She can’t wait to get in and get started as soon as they open the door.  If you’re in need of any physical therapy or rehabilitation services we highly recommend North Texas Animal Rehabilitation!
I have called and left vms to setup a consultation and havent heard a response. Moving on to someone else.

I have called this place multiple times over the last week and a half and have left voice mails and no one answers the phone or calls back. It seems like they deliberately send the calls to voicemail since sometimes it will ring once or sometimes 3 times or sometimes ring all the at through. This is supposed to be a location where you can get help with rehabilitation for your animals but how is that even possible if no one answers the phone or provides any information or assistance? There are hardly any reliable facilities in the area and the one attached to DVSC where my dog will be having surgery is practically useless

Jenny and the whole staff at NTX animal rehab are great!  I take my 10 y/o German Shepherd every other week for PT.  She runs around and jumps like a dog half her age!  And she loves the water treadmill.
